name: share-files
about: Chat sharing files from a Code chat's workspace into the conversation: one picture, then three (inline), then a Markdown file (a card). The workspace's pictures are drawn by the lab (made-up shapes), its notes.md made up. The thread's shots in both themes show how they look.
todo: The share-files tool wasn't on main when this was written (8 Nov 2026). Once it is: put its real name in the `used` checks (share_files here), and check where an answer keeps its file cards (scripts/lab/turns.mjs summarize → `files`).

files.text:
# Unit Shelf notes

- Tablespoons next (1 tbsp = 15 ml).
- Check what a cup is in other countries.
- The flour test rounds to 133 g.

steps.ask: Show me the picture pictures/sunrise.png from this workspace, here in the chat. No agent needed: just share it.
Now show me all three pictures in the pictures folder.
And share notes.md here as a file.
